paragraphs: BEA Transit Technologies supplies automated fare collection solutions for transit agencies in North America. The company states that it currently serves over 15,000,000 passengers per day.

The offering spans a back-end application and a mobile ticketing app alongside the fare equipment itself. Equipment is designed modularly with the transit industry in mind, so an installation can grow both in size and in added functionality. The company describes its fare equipment as the most adaptable on the market and its back-end office application as reliable. A ticketing vending machine also appears among the listed products.
The company says no fleet is too small for its systems. It describes itself as recognized in the transit industry for delivering on-time and in-budget quality systems.
